period_note: Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing used as the Q2 data point per project convention. Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Balance Sheet'/'Profit and Loss Account' (distinct from the 'Consolidated Balance Sheet'/'Consolidated Profit and Loss Account' shown alongside them in the same filing; legal name at the time was BRAC Bank Limited, pre-PLC conversion). Income-statement items use the 'Cumulative Jan to Jun 2011' column; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter end Apr to Jun 2011' column (interest income 3,346,986,443; PAT 384,765,741; EPS 11.53) not recorded here. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly (132,357,932,334 = 122,708,143,270 + 9,649,789,064). Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly (NII + Investment income + Commission + Other operating income = Total operating income; less opex = profit before provisions; less total provision = PBT; less tax = PAT). Consolidated comparison: consolidated PAT cumulative 855,584,168 vs solo 755,279,248; consolidated EPS cumulative 24.60 vs solo 23.07 — confirms this is a genuinely different (lower, less-diversified) basis than consolidated, consistent with the pattern already documented in the adjacent 2011_Q1/2011_Q3 filings. Matches the basis of this bank's own 2012-2016 Q4/annual series (solo). RESTATEMENT NOTE (data-quality check): the subsequent 2012 H1 filing's comparative 'Cumulative Jan to Jun 2011' column later restates this same period's interest income to 6,530,135,145 (vs. 6,578,829,503 reported here), interest expense to 4,570,849,198 (vs. 4,598,427,027), loan-loss provision to 1,014,869,322 (vs. 1,015,262,227), and consequently PAT to 734,555,625 (vs. 755,279,248 here, -2.7%) and EPS to 1.87 (vs. 23.07 here). The EPS change is overwhelmingly a retrospective weighted-average-share adjustment (BAS 33) driven by a bonus/rights issue that lifted paid-up capital from 3,212,352,000 to 3,854,822,400 between the two filing dates, not a comparable-magnitude profit restatement. Per project convention, the contemporaneous (originally-reported) figures are retained in this file rather than the later restatement.

source.source_page_lines: Balance Sheet as on 30 June 2011 (solo, p.5); Off Balance Sheet Items as on 30 June 2011 (solo, p.6); Profit and Loss Account for the period ended 30 June 2011 (solo, p.8)
source.retrieval_method: Genuinely CONTEMPORANEOUS Wayback capture (timestamp 20110929041316, archived 2011-09-29) while this filing was still live on bracbank.com — not a later recrawl/salvage — giving this quarter stronger provenance than most other quarters in this dataset. (legacy.bracbank.com, where BRAC Bank's filings moved in later years, is separately confirmed DNS-dead, but that domain issue does not apply to this particular capture.) Figures read directly from 150dpi page renders since the source is a scanned image PDF with no text layer; the retained .txt is empty as a result.
